content:
将 \(1\) 写成 \(\sum_{k=1}^n \frac1n\)，则

\[
\begin{aligned}
L_n
&=\sqrt n\left(1-\sum_{k=1}^n \frac1{n+\sqrt k}\right)\\
&=\sqrt n\sum_{k=1}^n\left(\frac1n-\frac1{n+\sqrt k}\right)\\
&=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{\sqrt k}{\sqrt n(n+\sqrt k)}.
\end{aligned}
\]

整理成黎曼和形式：

\[
\frac{\sqrt k}{\sqrt n(n+\sqrt k)}
=\frac1n\cdot \frac{\sqrt{k/n}}{1+\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\sqrt{k/n}}.
\]

因此

\[
L_n=\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n f_n\left(\frac{k}{n}\right),
\qquad
f_n(x)=\frac{\sqrt x}{1+\frac{\sqrt x}{\sqrt n}}.
\]

当 \(n\to\infty\) 时，\(f_n(x)\to \sqrt x\)，且在 \([0,1]\) 上一致收敛，所以

\[
L=\int_0^1 \sqrt x\,dx
=\left.\frac{2}{3}x^{3/2}\right|_0^1
=\frac23.
\]

答案：B
